answer: Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. Because the pulse weight is recomputed from the orchard history each close, the zephyr audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 2 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 25% of full weight. That is 12 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
